text:
Evelyn (Docs): I opened a small PR to sweep anchors across the Dedicated provisioning guide and polish a few examples. Main changes: consolidate near-duplicate anchors, add a CLI example for creating reserved pools, and tighten SLA phrasing. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/932 :memo:

Diego (Eng-Platform): Nice. Can you paste the new CLI/SDK snippets and the exact anchor renames? I'll run linkcheck and patch any stray API refs.

Evelyn (Docs): CLI snippet (new quick example):
```sh
# create a reserved pool via CLI
redwood infra create-pool --name core-hours --tenant-label org-99 --min 3 --max 12 --schedule "Mon-Fri:09:00-18:00"
```
SDK JS snippet (polished):
```js
await client.dedicated.createPool({
  name: 'core-hours',
  tenant_label: 'org-99',
  min_replicas: 3,
  max_replicas: 12
});
```
SDK Python snippet (explicit keywords):
```py
client.dedicated.create_pool(name='core-hours', tenant_label='org-99', min_replicas=3, max_replicas=12)
```
Anchors changed: #reserved-pools -> #reserved-pools-config, #fallbacks -> #fallback-behavior, added #cli-examples and #anchor-sweep-note.

Rina (Eng-ML): For the fallback examples, please add a single-sentence note about quality tradeoffs when the runtime picks a quantized fallback model. Something like: "When a quantized model is selected as a fallback, expect lowered inference quality and smaller memory/latency footprint." Also ensure code examples show `tenant_label` not `tenant_hint`.

Evelyn (Docs): Good catch  added that sentence and ran a grep to remove all `tenant_hint` occurrences in the docs tree. Left a short migration snippet under "Upgrading SDKs": `# migration: tenant_label = tenant_hint if present`

Omar (Eng-SRE): SLA phrasing nit: current draft used "best-effort fallback" in one paragraph. Suggest change to: "Fallback behavior may be invoked under sustained capacity pressure; customers using pinned reserved pools are excluded and should pin models to avoid fallback during critical windows." Avoid words like "guarantee" unless it's in the SLA table.

Evelyn (Docs): Reworded as suggested and added a pointer to the Dedicated SLA table.

Diego (Eng-Platform): Running local linkcheck: found two broken refs where the handbook TOC still pointed to #reserved-pools (old anchor). I pushed a fix to update the TOC to #reserved-pools-config and corrected an API sample that referenced `tenant_hint` in a comment.

docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #932

Rina (Eng-ML): Optional: include a tiny `fallback_priority` one-liner so users know the runtime picks in order. e.g. `fallback_priority: ['rdm-medium-v2','rdm-small-quant-v1']`. Helps set expectations for quality regressions.

Evelyn (Docs): Added the one-liner under Operational guidance. Also included a short monitoring sentence: "Monitor p95 latency and queue length; if p95 exceeds target for > 5m consider pinning or scaling up." Will note exact thresholds in follow-up doc when SRE provides them.

Omar (Eng-SRE): Please add a tiny Dedicated config example for pinning during scheduled peaks. Something like:
```yaml
reserved_pools:
  - name: core-hours
    tenant_label: org-99
    models: ['rdm-large-v3']
    schedule: 'Mon-Fri:09:00-18:00'
    pin: true
```
That shows customers how to exclude the pool from fallback behavior.

Evelyn (Docs): Done  included that snippet under "Operational pinning" and linked to the SLA table.

Diego (Eng-Platform): CI linkcheck passed locally after my TOC fix. I also found a stray reference to `tenant_hint` inside an inline example in /api-reference/dedicated.md; patched that. Static site build had a markdown-lint warning (list indent) which I adjusted in the PR.

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck ✅, build ✅, markdown-lint warnings: 1

Rina (Eng-ML): LGTM on the wording changes. One tiny ask: in the CLI example, can we show an explicit `--fallback-priority` flag to make the mapping discoverable? Not required but helpful.

Evelyn (Docs): Added `--fallback-priority rdm-medium-v2,rdm-small-quant-v1` to the CLI example and noted parsing details in a footnote.

Omar (Eng-SRE): Approve from SRE side after the SLA reword. Optional: add a short incident runbook pointer where docs remind on-call to check reserved pools first if users report degraded quality.

Evelyn (Docs): Added a one-line runbook pointer under Operational guidance. I'll follow up with a dedicated example PR for telemetry tags, and a TypeScript migration helper for tenant_label.

Diego (Eng-Platform): One last run: CI green, linkcheck green, merge when you're ready. Thanks for the sweep 

docs-bot: PR #932 merged to main (timestamp: 3890123620)
